newsitem.title: THAILAND: World's largest emerald cluster unveiled.
newsitem.headline: World's largest emerald cluster unveiled.

text.p: Gemologists have uncovered the world's largest known emerald cluster worth about US$50 million, after extracting it from what was thought by its owner to be a large black rock found in Madagascar.

Bangkok gemologists spent about a week removing a thick layer of black mica from the rock before finding a group of 127 medium green emeralds weighing 76 kilograms (167 lbs) or 380,000 carats, gem agent Jeffery Bergman told Reuters.
The unidentified owner of the cluster, who lives in the United Arab Emirates, was "rather thrilled and bewildered" by the find, he said.

The owner, who found the rock while mining in Madagascar five years ago, had an inkling it might be something special but had no idea that it would be that big until after an initial cleaning by gemologists revealed its splendour.
Bergman said he expected the emeralds to be bought by a private collector or a museum. The cluster has been certified by the Asian Institute of Gemological Sciences.
